description: Delete vectors by IDs or filter criteria.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Deletion confirmation with count of vectors removed, namespace affected, and list of deleted vector IDs if applicable
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently removes vectors from a namespace by ID list or metadata filter criteria
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: some or all vector IDs don't exist. NamespaceError: namespace not found. FilterError: invalid filter syntax. PermissionError: deletion not allowed on protected namespace.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found errors: verify vector IDs exist before deletion. For filter errors: check filter syntax matches supported operators. For permission errors: check if namespace allows deletion.
